text:
nina: heads-up from the qbringup bench: new qx8b-int4 profile shows a quality regression on our curated promptset for multistage summarization (differs on long doc split). bench link: https://dash.internal/redwood/bench/17654 :thinking:
omar: can you share the exact prompt slices and quant details? long-doc summarization is pretty sensitive to kv-cache/attention kernel changes.
chloe: quant used:
```
model: qx8b-int4
quant: int4
kernel: sparse-attn-opt
seq_cap: 8192
promptset: multisummarize-long-v1
```
kevin: did we apply pre-sampling dedupe? with huge seqs the fingerprinting sometimes collides because we only hash first 2048 tokens. we should run a suffix-aware fuzzyhash.
nina: we ran a prefix hash dedupe at sim>=0.9. i'll trigger a suffix-fuzzy dedupe and re-sample 400 examples. also will tag the samples for micro-golden.
omar: for labeling, prioritize examples that show hallucination and compression-loss. chloe, can you prepare a rubric (3 buckets: pass, compression_loss, hallucination) and a few seed examples?
chloe: yep. i'll post rubric and 30 seed gold examples by Tue. i can do a 400-sample micro-golden this week if ops confirms routing.
kevin: ops recs: 1) add int8-degrade route for seq>4096; 2) run kernel A/B: sparse-attn-opt vs sparse-attn-legacy; 3) run tokenizer parity on tokenization of large docs (float vs quant).
opsbot: deploy-canary: qx8b-int4 -> canary-multi started at 2025-06-05T11:02Z. logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/canary/176543
nina: thanks all. i'll push the suffix-aware dedupe script and the sample query to repo path: repo/curation/queries/multisum_long_repick.sql and ping once the queue has items. will update thread with micro-golden outcomes. :memo:
